title: Markdown Vault settings
description: The settings block of settings.yaml. _DEFAULT_SETTINGS in core/config.py is the runtime source of truth; this schema is the docs source (docs/settings.md generates from it) and a coverage test keeps the two in step.

interval.description: Seconds between automatic saves of a modified note.

default_mode.description: Which view a note opens in: edit, render or split.

hide_deprecated.description: Hide notes marked deprecated from the vault tree AND every search surface (a visible 'N hidden' notice remains). Spans pages, so it lives at the top level.

tab_width.description: Spaces a tab occupies in the editor.

wrap_text.description: Soft-wrap long lines in the editor.

allow_remote_images.description: Allow the preview to load images from remote URLs. Off by default, so a note cannot phone home when rendered.

min_width.description: Minimum tab width in pixels before the label ellipsizes.

wrap.description: Wrap the tab bar onto multiple rows instead of scrolling it.

switch_mode.description: Ctrl+Tab order: mru (most-recently-used switcher) or cycle (plain tab order).

next.description: Accelerator that selects the next tab.

prev.description: Accelerator that selects the previous tab.

level.description: Application log level, effective after restart.

disable_dmabuf.description: Export WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 at startup — a workaround for a black or broken preview on some GPU driver stacks.

disable_compositing.description: Export WEBKIT_DISABLE_COMPOSITING_MODE=1 at startup — a workaround for preview rendering glitches on some drivers.

autofix_normalize.description: On manual save, normalize whitespace inside [[wikilinks]].

autofix_relink.description: On manual save, redirect a broken [[wikilink]] when exactly one vault file matches its basename (moved/renamed/casing).

warn_on_save.description: After a manual save, inform about [[wikilinks]] that stay unresolved.

mark_broken.description: Mark broken [[wikilinks]] live in the editor (gutter warning triangle + red underline).

enabled.description: Enable semantic (vector) search and the Ask feature. Opt-in; off by default.

backend.description: Embedding backend: onnx (local, recommended), ollama (server) or openai (an OpenAI-compatible embeddings server).

min_score.description: Minimum similarity score for a passage to count as a semantic hit.

url.description: Ollama server URL used for embeddings.

model.description: Embedding model name for the OpenAI-compatible server. Empty is a configured-but-unusable state the UI names — no general default exists.

dir.description: Folder holding the ONNX files (model.onnx + tokenizer.json). Empty falls back to the app data dir default.

model_url.description: Download URL for the ONNX embedding model.

tokenizer_url.description: Download URL for the ONNX tokenizer.json.

engine.description: Answer engine: auto (the app configures backend, GPU offload and thread count), manual (honour the advanced ask.backend / ask.local settings) or off (no answers).

backend.description: Manual-mode chat backend: local (in-process GGUF via llama-cpp-python), ollama or openai (an OpenAI-compatible server). Only takes effect when ask.engine is manual.

reasoning.description: Let a reasoning model think before answering. Accurate but slower; only sent to the backend when False, so non-reasoning models are unaffected.

hybrid.description: Fuse a BM25 keyword ranking into the semantic retrieval, so exact tokens embeddings blur still surface.

top_k.description: How many notes are retrieved as context for an answer. Fewer is much faster on CPU.

num_ctx.description: Context window in tokens requested from the local and Ollama backends. The OpenAI backend sizes its context server-side and ignores this.

max_tokens.description: Hard cap on generated tokens per answer, so a repetition loop still stops.

system_prompt.description: Override the built-in Ask system prompt. Empty uses the built-in default.

url.description: Active server URL for the current server backend (ollama or openai).

model.description: Model name sent to the server backend.

model_by_endpoint.description: Remembered model per '<backend>|<url>' endpoint, so switching provider restores that provider's model. Managed by the app.

url_by_backend.description: Remembered server URL per backend, so switching does not point the new backend at the old host. Managed by the app.

n_gpu_layers.description: Transformer layers to offload to the GPU for the local backend. 0 = pure CPU (safe default).

n_threads.description: CPU threads for the local backend. 0 = half the physical cores, resolved at runtime.

n_batch.description: Logical prompt batch size (max tokens per decode). 0 = llama.cpp default.

n_ubatch.description: Physical prompt micro-batch size — the prefill-speed lever on the GPU. 0 = llama.cpp default; keep <= n_batch.

kv_type_k.description: KV-cache precision for the K cache. Quantizing K is free.

kv_type_v.description: KV-cache precision for the V cache. Below f16 requires flash attention.

flash_attn.description: Enable flash attention in the local backend.

use_mmap.description: Memory-map the model file. Off loads it fully into RAM (slower first load, no page-faults during the answer).

filename.description: GGUF filename inside ask.gguf.dir for the local backend (only the basename is used). Empty picks the newest model in the folder.

url.description: Pre-fill URL for the GGUF download button.

dir.description: Folder the Ask GGUF picker searches and downloads into. Empty uses the shared models dir; kept separate from the Whisper models.

whisper_model.description: Whisper model size for audio transcription on import. Bigger is more accurate, slower and a larger download.

import_last_dir.description: Directory the document-import file chooser reopens in. Managed by the app.

debug.description: Developer/diagnostic flags — NOT part of the default settings; absent unless you add them by hand or via Preferences → Debug when troubleshooting. Type-checked when present.

active.description: Developer flag: turn on extra diagnostic behaviour. For troubleshooting only.

dump.description: Developer flags: write a debug dump per named component (file_index, backlink_index, preview_html, vault_tree, tabs, sidebar, …). An open map — any component name is valid, its value must be boolean. For troubleshooting only.

x-dependencies.note: Only applies when ask.engine is 'manual'. With ask.engine 'auto' (the default) the app picks the backend and ask.backend is ignored.
The server url/model are read only when ask.backend is 'ollama' or 'openai'.
The llama.cpp runtime knobs are read only when ask.backend is 'local'.
The local GGUF file/folder are read only when ask.backend is 'local'.
Quantizing the V cache below f16 requires flash_attn: true.
